Control_Question: Has the organisation assigned responsibility for data protection governance?
Expected_Evidence: DPO appointment or data protection lead terms of reference
Owner: Appoint data protection lead/DPO where required and define responsibilities

Control_Question: Is data protection risk reviewed by senior management?
Owner: Add data protection and cyber risk as standing agenda items

Control_Question: Are policies reviewed at least annually?
Owner: Create policy review calendar and approval workflow

Control_Question: Does a Record of Processing Activities exist?
Expected_Evidence: ROPA document system inventory data map
Owner: Create ROPA covering residents staff suppliers and CCTV

Control_Question: Is lawful basis recorded for each processing activity?
Expected_Evidence: ROPA lawful basis column privacy notice mapping
Owner: Map Article 6 lawful basis and Article 9 condition

Control_Question: Is health and care data classified as special category data?
Expected_Evidence: Data classification standard care record access policy
Owner: Define classification and handling rules for health/care data

Control_Question: Are access controls role-based for care records?
Expected_Evidence: User access matrix access review report
Owner: Introduce quarterly access reviews and leaver checks

Control_Question: Are privacy notices clear and available to service users and families?
Expected_Evidence: Service user privacy notice website notice welcome pack
Owner: Update privacy notices using layered clear language

Control_Question: Does the staff privacy notice cover HR payroll DBS and monitoring?
Owner: Refresh staff notice and issue acknowledgement

Control_Question: Is there a documented SAR process?
Expected_Evidence: SAR procedure SAR log response templates
Owner: Create SAR workflow and log with due dates

Control_Question: Are staff trained to recognise rights requests?
Owner: Include rights requests in annual training

Control_Question: Is DPIA screening performed before new systems or high-risk processing?
Owner: Introduce DPIA screening for projects suppliers CCTV and monitoring

Control_Question: Is there a DPIA register?
Expected_Evidence: DPIA register completed DPIAs action tracker
Owner: Create DPIA register and review outstanding mitigations

Control_Question: Are regular sharing partners documented?
Owner: Map sharing with local authorities NHS GP pharmacy emergency services suppliers

Control_Question: Are data sharing agreements in place where appropriate?
Owner: Create or review agreements for controller-controller sharing

Control_Question: Are processor contracts reviewed for UK GDPR clauses?
Expected_Evidence: Supplier contracts DPA clauses due diligence checklist
Owner: Review processor clauses security requirements and deletion terms

Control_Question: Is supplier due diligence performed before onboarding?
Owner: Use supplier due diligence checklist before procurement

Control_Question: Is MFA enabled on email cloud and remote access?
Owner: Enable MFA for all privileged and remote access accounts

Control_Question: Are devices encrypted and protected by endpoint security?
Owner: Implement device encryption endpoint protection and device inventory

Control_Question: Is there an asset inventory for systems and devices?
Owner: Create asset inventory with ownership and criticality

Control_Question: Are vulnerabilities scanned and remediated to SLA?
Expected_Evidence: Vulnerability scan reports patch SLA dashboard
Owner: Define monthly scans and SLA for critical/high findings

Control_Question: Is there a breach response process?
Owner: Create breach checklist and ICO reporting decision log

Control_Question: Are incidents reviewed for lessons learned?
Owner: Add lessons learned actions to risk register

Control_Question: Is there a retention schedule for service user staff and supplier records?
Owner: Define retention periods and disposal approval process

Control_Question: Are paper and digital records securely destroyed?
Owner: Maintain disposal evidence and secure destruction contracts
